what: Plan's cap-boundary regression case contradicts the effective-cap comparison
scenario_or_breakage: The plan asks STARTING_ROUND=6 with five prior DEGRADED_ROUND=true files to assert mav-resume-past-cap, but the loop computes effective cap 10 and 6 > 10 is false, so the proposed test would fail or encode the wrong contract
suggested_fix: Revise the case to use DEGRADED_ROUND=false for rounds 1-5 when STARTING_ROUND=6, or keep five degraded rounds and set STARTING_ROUND=11; also fix the line claiming degraded inflation makes base_cap+1 past-cap

what: New gated test section is not wired into the accepted section list or lint shards
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds section_runs step5-starting-round, but the harness currently rejects any section except dispatch|convergence|parsers and make lint only runs the three section targets, while full test-review-and-fix is local-dev only
suggested_fix: Add step5-starting-round to the section allowlist, add a Makefile target such as test-review-and-fix-step5-starting-round, place it in a test-harnesses shard, and update the harness docs

what: The planned direct-source loop tests omit required dependencies
scenario_or_breakage: The parsers section can source review-implement-step5-loop.sh alone because it only calls parse helpers, but run_implement_loop needs emit_kv, larch_err, count_prior_degraded_rounds, and on some paths flush_review_batches or other review-and-fix helpers, so the new tests can fail before validating the behavior
suggested_fix: Specify the test scaffold: source scripts/lib-quiet.sh and scripts/lib-implement-round-cap.sh, or stub emit_kv/larch_err/emit_breadcrumb/flush_review_batches and any post-round helpers before calling run_implement_loop

what: The retry behavior may be left unvalidated
scenario_or_breakage: The plan allows the first-miss then present-on-retry case to become a covered-by-inspection skip, but the new acceptance criterion is specifically the two-attempt sync retry that prevents the false positive
suggested_fix: Make the retry test deterministic, for example by shadowing sync in the test shell so it creates the env file before the second probe, then assert the loop proceeds past the artifact guard
